rules.statement: a. `sources`: exactly one assessment for each source_id listed under `sources` in the CONTEXT block, and no other. prepared-pack is the CONTEXT block, not a source.

b. `consumers`: exactly one judgment for each module id listed under `consumers` in the CONTEXT block, and no other; its title and purpose there (module registry text) say what that consumer needs. CP-0 is this step, not a consumer.
c. A consumer whose readiness is not READY lists at least one limitation; a CONDITIONAL consumer also names its missing_source. A READY or READY_WITH_LIMITATIONS consumer cites located evidence.
d. A consumer's attached sources are exactly the sources its citations name, so cite every source the consumer relies on (and no source you would not attach).

e. Each citation names a SOURCE block's id, copies one `locator=` value from that block exactly (for example page:1: no brackets, ranges or notes) and quotes a verbatim substring of that span's text. Runs of whitespace and line breaks may be written as one space and curly quotes or dashes in ASCII; every other character is copied exactly, and the quote must be in the span its locator names. Copy a run that is contiguous in the SOURCE block as printed; never reassemble a sentence across interleaved table text. Never continue a quote onto the next page.
f. The CONTEXT block states each source's extraction coverage. Never call a page or locator absent when that coverage lists it.

g. A READY consumer attaches only verified sources without limitations and no gap names it; otherwise use READY_WITH_LIMITATIONS or lower. When issuer_confirmed is false, no consumer is READY or READY_WITH_LIMITATIONS. A source whose fidelity is not verified, or whose authority, entity or period is unknown, lists a limitation.

h. `analysis`: at least one evidence-grounded read-through entry; an empty list is rejected. `analysis[].text` is run text: digits only in period labels (`FY2025`, `Q3 2025`, `LTM`), filing and section labels (`Items 7, 7A`, `page:12`, `pages 16-18`), SEC file numbers (`001-36629`) and coverage counts (`195 of 195 pages`); every other figure belongs in a citation's quote, not in the text (the validator rejects a bare figure).
